method: Spatial-block delta-method SE for CP10k log mean ratio; t degrees of freedom from effective spatial block count; maximum P over all grid tilings.
null: Independent Poisson counts conditional on spatially correlated lognormal rates, mean CP10k constant across regions, fixed observed UMI per bin; stationary Gaussian kernel fields on padded native grid.
scope: Exploratory inference about bins of this T503 section. The simulations check the marginal false-positive rate at nominal alpha 0.05 for the specified fields. Smaller P-value tails, genome-wide FDR, and between-animal reproducibility were not assessed.
